messages:
Nina (People Ops): Heads-up team: the review window timeline is locked. Self-assessments close 2026-04-10 23:59 PT. Please use the web form: https://redwoodhr.company/reviews/self.

Ethan (Eng): Quick Q: if someone is onboarding and has <6 weeks of tenure, do they complete a full self-assessment?

Nina (People Ops): Good callout. New hires with <8 weeks should fill the condensed form (link on the main page) and tick 'onboarding review'. Managers will get separate guidance for ratings on those.

Priya (Manager): For managers: when does calibration happen? We have conflicting calendar invites in our team.

Nina (People Ops): Calibration blocks are week of 2026-04-20. Facilitated sessions run Tue/Wed/Thu AM. Managers should block 2hrs for the facilitator meeting + 90m per sync for roundtable if assigned. Full schedule will be posted Monday.

Noah (IC): Is the manager read-ahead required before calibration? I know some teams skip it.

Priya (Manager): We ask managers to complete read-aheads 48h before their calibration slot so facilitators can prep. It makes the sessions faster.

Sam (HR Bot): Reminder: Manager read-ahead checklist available in Console -> Reviews -> Manager Notes. Auto-export scheduled for 2026-04-19 08:00 PT.

Ethan (Eng): About promotion packets: should managers compile them or do ICs submit artifacts separately?

Nina (People Ops): ICs should indicate promotion intent on their self-assessment. Then managers create the promotion packet in the Promotion Tracker. We prefer manager-assembled packets for consistency. Templates in the docs.

Noah (IC): If someone needs to request a deadline shift because of parental leave, what's the process?

Nina (People Ops): Use the extensions form on the review page and cc your manager. For parental leave we'll typically grant a 1-week extension automatically on approval; longer needs a short note.

Priya (Manager): One procedural: managers should never change an IC's self-assessment content. Add comments in Manager Notes only. We had confusion last cycle.

Nina (People Ops): Correct. Edits to ratings happen during calibration. Manager Notes are the audit trail.

Ethan (Eng): Any updates on calibration confidentiality? Folks asked if notes are visible org-wide.

Nina (People Ops): Calibration discussions are private to managers + facilitators. Exported summaries share only final ratings and manager notes with Exec People Ops for approvals. Individual self-assessment text stays with manager view only.

Sam (HR Bot): Automated ping: 5 days remaining for self-assessments.

Noah (IC): Thanks. Also, can we get sample phrasing for impact statements? That helped last time.

Nina (People Ops): We'll post a cheat sheet (3-4 examples per level) and example artifacts by EOD today in #docs. Link will be in the calendar invite.

Priya (Manager): Thanks everyone. I'll remind my team in our Monday standup and share the consolidated CSV when it lands.

Nina (People Ops): Appreciate it. If managers need facilitator materials or want a mock calibration run, DM me.
